maneuver_plan.objective: Establish controlled robot-owned contact on ball_2 from the correct target-facing side, then execute local fetch to the target pose and monitor delivery.
replan_triggers: Perception becomes stale or inconsistent: state_age_s > 0.50 or confidence drops below 0.90.
Owned contact is not achieved during local_setup_capture, or the ball escapes / rolls away unexpectedly.
Corridor status changes to blocked, clearance falls below 0.30 m, or unsafe drift appears.
Post-setup alignment remains inadequate for push-ready validation.
During local fetch, contact is lost, ball deviates from the intended delivery line, or target progress stalls.
validation_gates: Perception gate: ball_confidence >= 0.95, target_confidence >= 0.95, and state_age_s <= 0.30 before setup begins.
Access gate: corridor.blocked == false, corridor.clearance_m >= 0.30, and unsafe_drift_m <= 0.05.

Setup-success gate: after local_setup_capture, robot has owned contact with the ball, no direct ball impulse condition remains satisfied, and ball is positioned on the target-facing side of the robot.
Push-ready gate: only continue if yaw/approach alignment to the ball-target line is materially improved from the current ~109.5 deg error and stable enough for deterministic local fetch execution.
Execution gate: local_fetch_to_pose may start only after validate_push_ready passes.
Delivery gate: monitor until ball reaches the target delivery radius of 0.30 m or a replan trigger fires.
